extDescription.message: Turn web pages into EPUB and send them to your Kindle via Gmail.

error_not_connected.message: Not connected to Google. Connect your account first.

error_auth_cancelled.message: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again.

error_auth_failed.message: Google sign-in failed. Please try again.

error_kindle_address_missing.message: Set your Kindle address in the settings first.

error_kindle_address_invalid.message: The Kindle address must end with @kindle.com.

error_too_large.message: The content is too large to send by email.

error_network.message: Network error. Check your connection and try again.

error_gmail_error.message: Gmail could not send the message.

error_extract_failed.message: Could not extract the content of this page.

amazonReminder.message: In your Amazon account, add the Gmail address above to the "Approved Personal Document E-mail List" (Content & Devices > Preferences > Personal Document Settings). Otherwise Amazon will discard the documents.

clientIdMissing.message: Google client ID not configured. Follow docs/setup-google-oauth.md and rebuild the extension.

error_scope_missing.message: The email-sending permission was not granted. Reconnect your account and tick the Gmail send permission.
